theme.coach: Tap the glowing stack to lift it. Then tap the numbered squares in order: one stone drops on each.
theme.how: **How a move works:** tap a stack to lift it. Then tap one square per stone, bottom stone first. Each stone can go to **any open square beside the last one**, so paths can turn. Dots show where the next stone can go. You can’t reuse a square in the same move. Tap the last numbered square again to take a stone back.

passages.name: Wander
passages.label: Origin · 2
passages.line: The long way is still a way
passages.mark: <path d="M6 26v-6h7v-7h-6V6h12v8h7v12"/><circle cx="6" cy="26" r="2.2" class="f"/><circle cx="26" cy="26" r="2.2" class="f"/>

theme.coach: **New: blooms.** A stone that lands on a flower turns over: light becomes dark, dark becomes light.
theme.how: **Wander:** a stone that lands on a **bloom** turns over, light to dark or dark to light. The dot on a bloom shows the color the stone will become.

passages.name: Bend
passages.label: Origin · 3
passages.line: Go around what you cannot cross

theme.coach: **New: water.** Stones can’t land in or cross water, so your path has to go around it.

passages.name: Hold
passages.label: Origin · 4
passages.line: Some things are meant to stay

theme.coach: **New: grass.** Stones can land on grass, but a stack on grass is held there for good. Plan the last stone carefully.
theme.how: **Hold:** anything that lands on **grass** stays put and can’t be lifted again.

passages.name: Anchor
passages.label: Origin · 5
passages.line: Build on what will not move

theme.coach: **New: tide-pool rocks.** Rocks never move. Stones can stack on top, and lifting that square lifts only the stones above the rock.

passages.name: Glide
passages.label: Origin · 6
passages.mark: <ellipse cx="21" cy="16" rx="6" ry="3.8" class="f"/><path d="M4 12h8M2 16h9M4 20h8"/><path d="M4 26h24" opacity=".5"/>

theme.coach: **New: ice.** A stone dropped onto ice slides one more square the same way. The dot shows where it will really end up.
theme.how: **Glide:** a stone that lands on **ice** slides one more square in the same direction (unless blocked). Dots always show the true landing spot.

passages.name: Ridge
passages.label: Veil · 1

theme.coach: **Veil.** Water blocks your path, just like in Bend.

passages.rule: Find the way along the ridge

passages.name: Falls
passages.label: Veil · 2

theme.coach: **New: falls.** A stone that lands on a fall is carried one square downhill. The dot shows where it really ends up.
theme.how: **Falls:** a stone landing on falling water is carried one square down.

passages.rule: Falls carry a stone one square downhill

passages.name: Laurel
passages.label: Veil · 3
passages.mark: <ellipse cx="11" cy="14" rx="5" ry="8" transform="rotate(-25 11 14)"/><ellipse cx="21" cy="14" rx="5" ry="8" transform="rotate(25 21 14)"/><path d="M16 28V12"/>

theme.coach: **New: laurel.** Your path can pass through laurel, but no stone rests there. Tap through it to keep going.
theme.how: **Laurel:** paths pass through laurel; no stone lands there.

passages.rule: Paths pass through the laurel; stones can’t rest there

passages.name: Moss
passages.label: Hush · 1
passages.line: Soft ground keeps what it’s given

theme.coach: **Hush.** Moss holds whatever lands on it for good.
theme.how: **Moss:** a stack on moss can’t be lifted again.

passages.name: Tidepool
passages.label: Hush · 2
passages.line: Between the tides, some things stay

theme.coach: Rocks stay put and water blocks. Build on the rocks.

passages.name: Cascade
passages.label: Hush · 3

theme.coach: Falls carry stones down; ferns let your path through.
theme.how: **Cascade:** falls carry stones down; paths pass through ferns.

passages.rule: Falls and fern: carried, and passed through

passages.name: Current
passages.label: Deep · 1

theme.coach: **Underwater.** The current carries a stone one square onward, in the direction of the arrows.
theme.how: **Current:** a stone landing in the current drifts one square with it.

passages.rule: The current carries a stone one square onward

passages.name: Seagrass
passages.label: Deep · 2

theme.coach: **New: seagrass.** Swim through it, but stones can’t settle in it.
theme.how: **Seagrass:** paths pass through; no stone lands there.

passages.rule: Swim through seagrass; stones can’t settle in it

passages.name: Reef
passages.label: Deep · 3

theme.coach: Coral never moves. Stack on it; lifting takes only the stones above.
theme.how: **Reef:** coral stays put; build on it.

passages.rule: Coral stays put; build on it

theme.coach: **New: glyphs.** The goal is an old sign drawn in stones. Lift the stacks and lay their stones out to draw it.
theme.how: **Glyphs:** the goal pattern is a picture. Every square must match, including the empty ones.
